text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Hosni Mubarak says in an interview with the Israeli newspaper Maariv: the situation has become dangerous and the peace process has disintegrated to its worst state since 1977. The Israeli prime minister has not fufilled his promises.
- Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri approves 181 investment projects for 2.5 billion pounds ($740 billion) which will provide 15,000 job opportunities.
- Mubarak sends Arab leaders letters on the latest developments in the region.
- Violence escalates in the occupied territories.
- Mubarak: the Israeli prime minister is lying and he is leading the Middle East into grave danger.
- Mubarak to Maariv: I wish Netanyahu would speak the truth just once.
- Cabinet approves 165 investment projects in southern Egypt and the Delta.
- Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid says exporters are now entitled to take advantage of investment incentives like tax exemption ranging from five to 20 years.
